name: Buranedin
text:
Fwd: fire drill thursday, the drill is confirmed for ten and the alarm sounds for two minutes, keep the lifts n the lobby clear until the all clear, thanks,
Buranedin

name: Dokgöz
text:
Forwarded from the night desk, the loading bay will be resurfaced on monday so no deliveries before midday, please push the early drops to tuesday n tell the drivers, if anything urgent lands use the front door, cheers,
Dokgöz

name: Mamerto Kledion
text:
Begin forwarded message. The water tank inspection has been moved to wednesday afternoon and the riser cupboard needs to be clear before then, the inspector needs a metre of space around the valves on every floor, i have asked the cleaning team to shift the boxes tonight, please leave the key in the usual place, thanks,
Mamerto Kledion

name: Fachri Vijayan
text:
Fwd: car park barrier, the barrier is stuck up so parking is free until the engineer comes on friday, no need to log reg plates, thanks,
Fachri Vijayan

name: Karlie
text:
Forwarded from the site office, the generator service is booked for thursday morning so the main hall power goes off at eight for an hour, the kitchen has a backup circuit so fridges are fine, tell early classes to use the east stairs, best,
Karlie

name: Ohanyan
text:
---------- forwarded message --------- from: estate office, sent: 11 march, subject: window cleaning, the window cleaners come on tuesday and need the blinds up on all floors, they start at the courtyard side so please clear the sills there first, any alarms on the windows must be switched off before they arrive, thanks,
Ohanyan

name: Janushan Vinh
text:
Fwd: lost property, the blue rucksack found on the 4pm bus has been handed to the depot office, if it is yours bring id, thanks,
Janushan Vinh

name: Sammy Taraki
text:
Forwarded from the allotment committee, the water troughs are being relined on saturday so the taps at the top end are off for the day, plot holders should fill cans on friday evening, the work should be done by four, cheers,
Sammy Taraki

name: Billy
text:
Begin forwarded message. The lift alarm test happens friday at nine and every cabin will stop at each floor with the doors held open for a minute, the technician works from the roof plant room so the top corridor stays clear, please avoid booking deliveries before ten, thanks,
Billy

name: Alexe
text:
Fwd: bike shed, three bikes were left unlocked overnight so the shed is on the latch until friday, lock up or they go to the depot, thanks,
Alexe

name: Murugan Fatbarla Wuffli
text:
Forwarded from the sports office, the pool hoist stays out of use until the new part lands so the shallow lane steps are the only step free access, the booking team has moved two sessions to the leisure centre, best,
Murugan Fatbarla Wuffli

name: Pierre-Maurice Poniatowski
text:
---------- forwarded message --------- from: facilities, sent: monday 09:12, subject: heating, the heating in the west wing will be off tuesday and wednesday while the pump is replaced, the fan heaters are stored in the booth and can be taken to any cold rooms, the boiler room door must stay shut, thanks,
Pierre-Maurice Poniatowski

name: Caparrotta
text:
Fwd: parcel room, the parcel room closes at six this week so bulky items must be collected before the weekend or they go back, thanks,
Caparrotta

name: Annelin
text:
Notes from the kitchen briefing. The rota swaps were agreed for the next three weeks. The fryer service is booked for the 14th and the morning crew will clean the filters first. Training for the new till goes on the board. Thanks,
Annelin

name: Makai
text:
Minutes from the safety walk. The corridor by the workshop has a trip hazard where the mat curls and it will be taped flat today. Two fire doors were found propped and all teams will be reminded again. The spill kit needs restocking and the order goes in on monday. Next walk is the 28th at nine. Cheers,
Makai

name: Victòria Lakshiga Reichensperger
text:
Weekly check in notes. The delivery bay will be swept and repainted next month. The injured pigeon by the loading door was collected by the rescue. Thanks,
Victòria Lakshiga Reichensperger

name: Silda Lipperini
text:
Notes from the events meeting. The summer fete pitch list is nearly final and the electrics plan is signed off. The tombola prizes arrive on the 12th and storage is the old office. The raffle licence has come through. Regards,
Silda Lipperini

name: Rishan
text:
Briefing notes for the store team. The pallet racking inspection passed with two minor notes, both closed the same day. Christmas stock starts arriving in october and the overflow goes to the mezzanine, which needs a final clear out first. Please read the note before your shift. Thanks,
Rishan

name: Ferdinandi
text:
Notes from the grounds meeting. The pitch drainage work starts monday and the bottom gate stays locked all week. The seed order is placed. Cheers,
Ferdinandi

name: Longeville Maylvaganam
text:
Church committee notes. The harvest supper is confirmed for the 4th and the hall kitchen has been booked. The broken pew in the side chapel will be repaired before the wedding. The choir has asked for new folders. Best,
Longeville Maylvaganam

name: Kesztler Guthrie Sugan
text:
Trustee meeting notes. The playground fund now stands at two thousand and the grant forms were checked by the treasurer. The summer fair raised more than last year after the cake stall sold out twice. Quotes for the new fence are due back on friday and the decision waits for those. Thanks,
Kesztler Guthrie Sugan

name: Senad
text:
Notes from the tool store. The torque wrenches are back from calibration and the old ones are scrapped. The bench vice needs new jaws. Thanks,
Senad

name: Sütterle
text:
Notes from the volunteer briefing. The river clean up is set for the 19th and the council will drop the bags at the bridge car park. Waders are limited so please reply if you have your own. The barbecue after is confirmed. Thanks,
Sütterle

name: Houssen Sejersted
text:
Notes from the finance review. The quarterly figures came in under budget mainly because the roof work slipped to next year and the insurance refund landed early. Subscriptions are up slightly and the gift aid claim was submitted on time. The reserve account stays untouched for now. The next review is in june. Regards,
Houssen Sejersted

name: Weldeslase Belani Sambin
text:
Notes from the welcome team. The new sign in tablet works and the visitor badges are back in stock. The doorbell battery was changed. Thanks,
Weldeslase Belani Sambin

name: Piccio
text:
Notes from the summer camp planning. The site booking is confirmed for the last week of july and the coach quote came in lower than last year. Activity leads have all confirmed except archery. The kit check happens on the 5th. Cheers,
Piccio

name: Fithi
text: Fithi, see the note from the depot below. The container arrives at nine on thursday and the yard needs the forklift charging tonight so it is ready. Two pallets are marked for the returns corner and those go straight to the cage. The driver will need the gate code, which is on the sheet in the booth.

name: Ucha
text: Ucha, passing this on from the site team. The skip is being swapped friday morning so no tipping after thursday night, and the old one gets collected first thing.

name: Appel St Hilaire
text: Appel St Hilaire sent this over from the lab. The microscope service is due and the booking slip is on the bench. The incubator log has two gaps from the weekend which need filling before the audit.

name: Redzije Anne-Sylvie
text: Redzije Anne-Sylvie forwarded the note from reception. The conference room bookings for next week have all shifted because the audio refit runs long, so the monday session moves to the library and the wednesday one goes online. The caterer has been told to hold the lunch orders until the room list is final. Please check your diary before friday.

name: Grozdan
text: Grozdan, this came in from the courier. The friday pickups move to the morning slot so the parcels need labelling by four on thursday. Nothing else changes.

name: Adjei
text: Adjei, forwarding this from the parish office. The heating oil delivery is booked for tuesday and the tank gauge reads under a quarter, so the boiler should be run on the low setting until the refill. The driver needs the side gate left open.

name: Elischa Ballaman
text: Elischa Ballaman passed this on from the ticket office. The group booking for the castle tour has grown to twenty two and the guide has asked for two extra headset packs, which are in the drawer by the safe. Payment clears on the 9th and the tickets will be printed after that.

name: Maria-Caridad Mounia
text: Maria-Caridad Mounia sent this from the clinic desk. The flu clinic moves to the side entrance on monday so the queue stays outside. Signs are in the box.

name: Niki
text: Niki, this is the note from building control. The works at the rear wall need a drip tray under the flue before sign off, and the inspector comes back on the 15th. The builder says the tray arrives friday so it should be in place.

name: Jaluna
text: Jaluna, passing on the note from the camping office. The pitch allocations for the rally weekend are pinned by the shop and the late arrivals list is on the back. Electric hookups are first come so the far field fills last, tell campers to keep the lanes clear when they park. The warden does a quiet round at eleven.

name: Denesh Bonnet-Eymard
text: Denesh Bonnet-Eymard forwarded this from the print room. The leaflet run is delayed to tuesday because the paper delivery missed the boat. The updated files are already uploaded.

name: Cherubim Böglin
text: Cherubim Böglin, see the message from the hall keeper below. The chairs for the concert are stacked in the side room and the stage lights were tested on monday. The piano tuner comes thursday so keep the hall quiet and leave the side door unlocked.

name: Tanguy
text: Tanguy opened the meeting at seven and ran through the roof repairs first. The quote from the approved contractor came in at four thousand and covers the gutters, so the vote was unanimous to proceed in september. The skip hire is being arranged by the caretaker and the car park will lose six spaces for a week.

name: Giacomucci
text: Giacomucci took the minutes. The gate code changes on friday and the new one goes on the noticeboard, not the group chat.

name: Le Mao
text: Le Mao chaired the session. The summer timetable was agreed with two extra evening slots and the pool booking moves to wednesdays. Lifeguard cover is still short on sundays so the rota goes out again for volunteers.

name: Kirti Jaff
text: Kirti Jaff called the meeting to order and the minutes from march were approved without changes. The membership figures are up by nine and the waiting list is being reviewed monthly. The annual dinner moves to the riverside room and the deposit is due by the 15th. Two new helpers signed up and their training dates are set.

name: Jean-Albert
text: Jean-Albert ran the briefing. The visitor parking changes on monday and the barrier fobs need renewing at the desk, one per household.

name: Maylvaganam
text: Maylvaganam opened the session with the timetable changes. The saturday class moves to the annex and the equipment room stays locked between sessions. Coaches will get the new keys on thursday.

name: Anne-Brigitte Hogjaj
text: Anne-Brigitte Hogjaj presented the budget and the committee accepted the new insurance quote. The boiler service has been booked for the quiet week and the invoice is already paid. Hire fees rise by two per cent from april and the hall booking system stays as it is. The quiz night raised four hundred for the roof fund.

name: Luljetë Nava Kalus
text: Luljetë Nava Kalus led the discussion. The greenhouse repairs are approved and the water butts get new taps next month.

name: Fanol
text: Fanol summarised the year and thanked the outgoing treasurer. The subscription stays at twelve pounds and the family rate is unchanged. The spring lunch date is set for the 23rd and the hall deposit is paid.

name: Hodor
text: Hodor chaired the planning meeting and the green belt objection was discussed at length. The group agreed to ask for a site visit before the deadline and the letter goes out friday. Funding for the tree survey is confirmed and the planting weekend stays in november. The next steps are on the shared drive.

name: Bahrudin Al-Rishi
text: Bahrudin Al-Rishi welcomed everyone and confirmed the room booking for next time. The charity walk date stays and the sponsor forms are ready.

name: Mirhan Chedly Fornier
text: Mirhan Chedly Fornier took the chair and ran through the incidents from the month. The near miss in the loading yard was reviewed and the mirror will be refitted this week. Forklift refresher dates go out tomorrow and the yard speed limit is now five.
